headline: 影视双榜热战：耳语人领跑，鼠惑称霸
headlineEn: Movie and TV dual charts: Whisperer leads, Rat Mystery dominates
summary: 今日新片零上映，但《耳语人》领跑电影热度；电视剧《鼠惑》双榜登顶，科幻剧《末日地堡》紧随其后。
summaryEn: No new films today, but 'Whisperer' tops movie heat; TV series 'Rat Mystery' leads both charts, with sci-fi 'Doomsday Bunker' close behind.

industryHighlights.text: 今日无新片上映，本周仅5部新片
industryHighlights.en: No new films today, only 5 new movies this week.

industryHighlights.text: 《鼠惑》同时登顶电影和电视剧热度榜
industryHighlights.en: 'Rat Mystery' tops both movie and TV heat charts simultaneously.

industryHighlights.text: 《末日地堡》跨电影电视剧双榜在列
industryHighlights.en: 'Doomsday Bunker' appears on both movie and TV trending lists.
'Dark Matter' ranks in the top three TV series today.

industryHighlights.text: 下周无高关注作品定档
